stemMd: An account contains 3,000 euros. Exactly one year of simple interest brings it to 3,135 euros. What is the annual rate?
explanationMd: Interest is 135 on principal 3000, so rate=135/3000=0.045. Express this as 4.5 percent.

distractorRationale.a: Uses the final balance as the interest base.
distractorRationale.c: Uses a principal of 1000 instead of 3000.
